content:
Hi all! I have been implementing a DSL in Lean and am interested in using Verso. Here is my current Q:

In my DSL, I have implemented custom hovers. So I can write code like this: 

#dsl -- Replaces top-level parser with custom commands

my_def foo := 32 -- In parser category `dsl_command`, which hooks into a special elaborator

When I hover over 32, I see Num. This happens due to the following code ran during the type checking phase of the DSL, which runs inside of MetaM: 

def addHoverInfo (stx : Syntax) (s : String) : MetaM Unit :=
  withEnableInfoTree true do
    pushInfoLeaf <| .ofDelabTermInfo {
      elaborator := `DSL.addHoverInfo
      stx := stx
      lctx := (← getLCtx)
      expectedType? := none
      expr := mkConst ``Unit
      docString? := some s!"`{s}`"
    }

Is it possible to get this information to show in Verso when I run the same block of code in Lean mode? Currently, the code works and has the correct hovers from within the IDE, but when sent to HTML I see raw text (although the keywords are correctly highlighted). Happy to provide more information if helpful. Thanks so much!

This is definitely possible to implement, but I'm not sure I'll have the time in the next month or two.

In case you want to give it a shot, the place to put the code to handle it is here. You'd then add a case for ofDelabTermInfo, and then additionally add support for it to the highlighted code datatype.

The next step is to see which pattern matches in Verso itself need fixing, as you add HTML and TeX backends for it (where the latter can basically just skip it).

Where you might run into issues is that Verso's HTML hovers are a bit fewer - to keep the HTML compact, they're saved for each identifier, but not for every sub-term. Some of the hover-showing code bakes that assumption in, so you might have to generalize it a bit as well.

Finally, you'd have to be on the lookout for other uses of ofDelabTermInfo that you _didn't _ want in the HTML. That may require creativity, like passing the code highlighter a list of the elaborator fields that you want to include.
